# Synthetic Customer-Confirmed CIO Assurance Workshop Record

Publisher: Northstar CIO Working Group - Synthetic
Published: 2026-06-19
Classification: Synthetic customer-confirmed test context

In this synthetic test scenario, the customer CIO workshop confirms privileged-access evidence completeness and traceable, human-owned reviewer decisions as account priorities.

The workshop also confirms that `campaign_id` and `entitlement_id` are present in the frozen evidence and exception exports. The Access Governance Manager owns the approved evidence checklist and final-disposition set, and 120 completed exceptions are available after identity-data access approval.

The record does not establish product availability, deployment compatibility, operating baselines, pilot approval, or a funded business case.
